text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development approach helps teams respond quickly to changes, deliver working results sooner, and continuously improve their product based on feedback.
